title: Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - Competitively Bid - Tulum Innovative Engineering – Santa Fe SPED @ Santa Fe Phone/ Data Installation Project – Division of Facilities Planning & Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - Competitively Bid - between the District and Tulum Innovative Engineering (“Consultant”), Oakland, CA,  for the latter to provide installation of approximately 300 CAT 6A Cables (and associated patch panels, wire managers and jacks) per the locations and room quantities identified on the information provided; approximately 85 phone lines, 143 computer lines and 4 fax lines, with telephone line having a WHITE CAT 6A cable; data line having a BLUE CAT 6A cable, for the Santa Fe SPED @ Santa Fe Phone/ Data Installation Project, in the amount of $98,000.00, as the selected Consultant, with work scheduled to commence on September 24, 2020, and concluded on December 23, 2020.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Hires Tulum Innovative Engineering for $98,000 phone and data cabling at Santa Fe
summary: The district chose Tulum Innovative Engineering of Oakland, through competitive bidding, to install about 300 data cables with patch panels and jacks for the Santa Fe special education site. The work covers about 85 phone lines, 143 computer lines and 4 fax lines. It is scheduled to run from September 24 to December 23, 2020.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
title: Amendment No. 1, General Services Agreement - Nor-Cal Moving Services - Cole Administration Move Relocation Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, General  Services Agreement between the District and Nor-Cal Moving Services, Hayward, CA, for the latter to provide additional moving services which consists of relocating all furniture from all the class rooms into the multipurpose room, as described in the proposal dated July 2, 2020, attached to Amendment as part of Exhibit A, for the Cole Administration Move Relocation Project, in an additional amount of $6,000.00, increasing Agreement not to exceed amount from $27,800.00 to $33,800.00, authorizing the President and Secretary of the Board to sign the Amendment for same with said Consultant. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $6,000 for Nor-Cal Moving Services on the Cole Administration move
summary: This changes an existing moving contract with Nor-Cal Moving Services of Hayward. The added money pays to move all furniture from the classrooms into the multipurpose room for the Cole Administration Move Relocation Project. The contract limit rises from $27,800.00 to $33,800.00, and all other terms stay the same.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
